estimates.assumptions: A whole chicken is typically 2.5-3 lbs (1130-1360g) with bones/skin; used average 1100g edible yield after trimming, matching supplied 119 cal/100g for raw chicken with skin.
2 quarts (1893 ml) frying oil; only a fraction adheres/absorbs into chicken (realistic ~5% of total oil mass for deep-frying estimate).
2 tsp onion salt ~11g (density ~5.5g/tsp); typical mixed seasoning calories, modest amount as flavoring.
1 tsp black pepper ~2g (density ~2g/tsp); copied supplied knownCaloriesPer100g exactly.
1/2 tsp celery salt ~3g (density ~6g/tsp); typical mixed seasoning calories, modest amount as flavoring.
